overview: NOVA is a full-stack project management app where teams plan, collaborate, and deliver with projects, tasks, a Kanban board, and progress dashboards.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and manage Admin/Member roles
Create, edit, and manage projects with team members
Track tasks on a drag-and-drop Kanban board
Comment on tasks and follow a per-project activity log
View dashboards with progress bars and overdue task tracking
